about_the_game:
Feign – Deluxe Pack

Designed especially for players who want to take their Feign experience to the next level, the Deluxe Pack offers an extensive array of cosmetics and in‑game advantages.

Pack Contents:

  • 7 different loungewear costumes

  • 16 head costumes

  • 12 face costumes

  • Original game soundtrack (OST)

  • 700 in‑game gold

With this comprehensive pack, you can customize your character in detail, relive the game’s atmosphere with the OST, and enjoy a head start from your very first match. The Deluxe Pack is crafted for players aiming to stand out in the world of Feign.
